d: Chestnut brown hair is medium-length and wind-swept with choppy bangs, accented by two large yellow bows. The build is slender, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt under a dark grey sleeveless vest, a green necktie, and a pleated dark grey miniskirt paired with striped thigh-high stockings.
